summary: This guide showcases an updated Thunderbolt team tackling Round 2 Level 200 Fire Guardians in the Season 9 Crown Contest, dealing over 3.46 billion damage. The two crucial mechanics for the encounter are building at least 300 Resistance on all heroes to counter 270 enemy Accuracy, and prioritizing Attack and Enlightenment over critical stats. Because Thunderbolt's derivative damage cannot crit, Crit Rate and Crit Damage are entirely useless. Perkunte serves as the primary damage carry alongside Alaura, with Maashtur providing solo healing.

teams.note: Scored 3.465 billion damage; all heroes require ~300 Resistance or more, with damage dealers stacking Attack and Enlightenment instead of Crit stats.

tips: Build around 300 Resistance or more on every hero to resist the Level 200 Fire Guardians' recharging speed penalty (they have 270 Accuracy).
Do not build Crit Rate or Crit Damage on Thunderbolt damage dealers against this boss because derivative damage cannot crit; stack Attack and Enlightenment instead.
Equip the Might of the Inferno gear set to boost derivative damage by 10% for the wearer and nearby allies within 1 tile.
title: Updated Thunderbolt Team vs Fire Guardians Lv 200 | Crown Contest Round 2 | Dragonheir | Season 9
